initial_ai_issue: AI suggested permitting HTTP because the server was reachable by ping.
reviewer_reason: Reviewer identified an explicit ACL deny for TCP/80 appearing before the permit.
correction_action: Use ACL sequence/order evidence; inspect and correct the rule order.

initial_ai_issue: AI blamed ARP instability without identifying duplicate addressing.
reviewer_reason: Two hosts were configured with the same IP and show arp mapped it to different MACs.
correction_action: Correct duplicate IP first; verify ARP stability afterward.

initial_ai_issue: AI treated guest-to-server reachability as a routing problem.
reviewer_reason: The guest ACL explicitly permitted the internal network, making this a security-policy failure.
correction_action: Reject the diagnosis; restrict guest ACL before further routing changes.

initial_ai_issue: AI said the Internet connection was down because DNS lookup failed.
reviewer_reason: 8.8.8.8 was reachable, proving basic IP connectivity; the evidence showed a wrong DNS server.
correction_action: Separate Layer 3 reachability from Layer 7 DNS resolution.

initial_ai_issue: AI recommended adding another static route even though the route existed.
reviewer_reason: show ip route already contained the destination, but the next-hop interface was down.
correction_action: Check next-hop/interface state before adding routes.
